clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau points to three places toxins build up before they ever reach your plate: the food, the water and the air.

His own fix for water: a whole-house filtration system that runs through a pre-filter, then granular activated charcoal, then an ultraviolet light stage for bacteria and viruses.

By the time it reaches a glass, he says that process has pulled out a long list of chemicals and contaminants most tap water carries straight through.
